name: Admin Accounting Income Reminder Mute
description: A superuser can silence the payment-calendar reminders of one uncollected expected income from its row menu, either until a future date or indefinitely. The Cobro cell shows the muted state and its resume date, so a deliberately quiet receivable cannot look unmonitored. A muted row offers Reactivar avisos, which clears both mute fields immediately. The modal rejects empty or non-future resume dates, and an API failure keeps the modal open and the row unchanged. Only expected, not-fully-paid incomes expose the action; the dedicated POST /api/accounting/incomes/:id/mute/ endpoint audits the change without generating another accounting email.
